name: Wings Innocent
source:
A story about dormitory students that share a room and gradually get closer without being able to convey their feelings. Until one day...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一群寄宿学生同住一个房间。他们无法传达自己的感情，却在朝夕相处中逐渐拉近距离。直到有一天…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
